description: This file defines asynchronous service functions for course management in an LMS backend, including creating, listing, retrieving, updating, and deleting courses, interfacing with a MongoDB database through abstracted repository functions.

methods.name: str create_course(db: AsyncIOMotorDatabase, instructor_id: str, data: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Creates a new course in the database with provided instructor ID and data.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,Any]] list_courses(db: AsyncIOMotorDatabase, limit: int = 50, skip: int = 0)
methods.description: Lists courses with optional limit and skip parameters for pagination.

methods.name: Optional[Dict[str,Any]] get_course(db: AsyncIOMotorDatabase, course_id: str)
methods.description: Retrieves a course by its ID.

methods.name: bool update_course(db: AsyncIOMotorDatabase, course_id: str, updates: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Updates an existing course identified by course ID with provided data.

methods.name: bool delete_course(db: AsyncIOMotorDatabase, course_id: str)
methods.description: Deletes a course specified by course ID.
